notes.title: Supreme Ruler Global Outbreak Now Available
notes.content:
BattleGoat Studios is pleased to announce the release of the latest title in the Supreme Ruler series.
Supreme Ruler Global Outbreak is a Geopolitical Strategy Survival game where players can play from any real world region in the modern day and deal with viral outbreaks of either a renewed COVID infection or the classic threat of a zombie invasion. 

[list]
[*] The latest Supreme Ruler game engine including the regular 2030 start
[*] Play out the genesis of a zombie invasion in the year 2020 to try and save humanity
[*] Play out the survival of humanity in the year 2021 after a partial victory over the zombies
[*] Face a renewed COVID outbreak in the year 2030 amidst various global tensions
[*] Over 300 playable nations, many with colonies which can be directly controlled.
[*] Use Diplomacy, Trade, and Espionage as the world grapples with an existential threat
[*] Extensive tech tree representing where humanity was heading before the crisis and new technologies for emerging threats
[*] Realistic current and near future military equipment for country inventories.
[*] Sophisticated Real-Time Strategic and Tactical Control of your Military Forces.
[*] Up to 16 players in Online Multiplayer 
[/list]

You can find the game trailer here;
[previewyoutube=JD4M7ZIStjE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo Update poste
notes.content:
A new update was posted today, bringing the demo up to v.1346. This update includes lost of fixes and changes made for the core game and lots of changes focused on the zombie and infection mechanics for this title. We've posted a video on our YouTube channel discussing some of the progress we've made;

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zPy6twLcLQY

For this demo the zombie stats and behaviours have been change extensively. If you played it before, you'll find it plays much differently now. The zombies are still super tough, but players can make progress in some areas and the zombie behaviours are more in line with what players would expect from a zombie faction.

As always, we'd appreciate feedback on the game. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Supreme Ruler Global Outbreak LiveStream
notes.content:
[i]Supreme Ruler Global Outbreak[/i] is a Survival Geopolitical Strategy game for PC, developed by BattleGoat Studios. 

The game has been created using the next generation Supreme Ruler engine, developed originally for [i]Supreme Ruler 2030[/i], released in 2023, and is still being further developed. Ongoing work will in most cases see both projects benefit from new features, fixes and improvements.

The demo for Supreme Ruler Global Outbreak is currently featured in the Steam Nextfest, June 10th to 17th. The demo includes the first sandbox map for the game, Zombie outbreak, and tutorials to learn how to play. The full game will include 2 sandboxes, 2 campaigns and a scenario. Watch for more details coming soon. You can see the announcement video we created at this link;
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YYYjQABgW3A&t=3s

Supreme Ruler games offer players the opportunity to take on the role of the leader of a country of their choice. Nearly all present day countries and regions are represented, from Afghanistan to Zimbabwe. Players have control over the finances, industries, military, research and diplomacy of the selected country. Gameplay is in variable speed real time, allowing actions while paused for planning and faster speeds to watch the action unfold.

The Global Outbreak setting offers players new challenges of a world where emerging outbreaks threaten humanity's survival. Governing your country is much more challenging as the world threatens to crumble around you. The challenge shifts from can you win, to can you survive.

For more than 40 years, the Supreme Ruler series has offered players deep and engaging strategy simulations. The series began with the original release of the first text-based Supreme Ruler game on the TRS-80 computer in 1982, making Supreme Ruler the longest running PC game franchise in development. Thank you to all our players, fans, and supporters for making this possible!
